Technical Inquiries

How does Ceres handle legacy ERP data?

Our integration layer uses universal connectors and proprietary normalization protocols to extract and synthesize data from any legacy system without modification of the source.

What is the security standard?

All data is encrypted at rest and in transit using AES-256 and TLS 1.3. We offer on-premise, air-gapped, and sovereign cloud deployment options for highly sensitive operations.

Is the AI model explainable?

Yes. Our "White Box" philosophy ensures every decision output is accompanied by a transparent logic trail, allowing analysts to audit the reasoning behind any predictive signal.

Can we customize the dashboard?

The Unified Console is fully modular. Users can build custom views, alert triggers, and reporting templates based on specific operational KPIs and command structures.
